about: Computed by scripts/xuat_ban_phat_hanh_v2.py with the ORIGINAL repository code: lines from data/cache_e2/rows.json (the lines the paper scored), draws from experiment_phu_quet_luoi.cac_lan_boc, scorer e2_allocation_158.score_rows, bootstrap e2_allocation_158.paired, split r1_thang_chinh_sach.policy_split, sign-flip r1_thang_chinh_sach.signflip. code/reproduce.py recomputes all of it from the release.
protocol_note: official score = mean of R@k, k in {1,5,20,50,100}; windows +-6/10/20 averaged; true moment uniform in the anchor's keyframe cell; 4x48 draws, seed root 930000, drawn once over the 158-item list and sliced (common random numbers); paired query-level percentile bootstrap, 4,000 resamples, seed 4242; sign-flip test 10,000 flips, seed 20260924; split seed 20260917
